subject.title: fix(msteams): escape markup in mention display names

question: Should this PR wait for redacted real Teams send/render proof, or may maintainers waive that gate based on the parser, jsdom, Microsoft mention contract, and loopback wire-capture evidence?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and source-backed, but the changed behavior is an external Teams delivery/rendering path and the current proof stops before a real Teams client or connector log.

options.title: Require Real Teams Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted screenshot, recording, runtime send log, connector response, or linked artifact showing a display name with `&`, `<`, or `>` delivers as one intended mention.

options.title: Waive The Proof Gate
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the local parser and loopback transport proof for this narrow escaping change and proceed with normal merge review.

options.title: Pause For Teams Owner
options.body: Keep the PR open for a Teams-area owner to decide whether the remaining client-rendering uncertainty is acceptable.

recommendation.title: Require Real Teams Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted screenshot, recording, runtime send log, connector response, or linked artifact showing a display name with `&`, `<`, or `>` delivers as one intended mention.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` has both committer and hardening history on the Teams mention parser and send path, making him the best available proof-sufficiency owner from the history trail.
